sloka: यान्ति राजर्षयः च अत्र मृगयाम् धर्म कोविदाः ।तस्मात् त्वम् निहतो युद्धे मया बाणेन वानर ।अयुध्यन् प्रतियुध्यन् वा यस्मात् शाखा मृगो हि असि ॥४-१८-४०॥
transliteration: yānti rājarṣayaḥ ca atra mṛgayām dharma kovidāḥ ।tasmāt tvam nihato yuddhe mayā bāṇena vānara ।ayudhyan pratiyudhyan vā yasmāt śākhā mṛgo hi asi ॥4-18-40॥

translations.english: 'People seeking animal flesh for food kill animals alarmed or unalarmed, animals that run away or animals that stand still. They kill animals whether they are alert or not and no blemish is attached.
